answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust defense for AI economies, ensuring that influence scales with capital locked at the dawn of a protocol. By requiring agents to pledge assets like quartz or falcon tokens, the network forces an attacker to incur prohibitive economic costs. Because identity verification is linked to stake rather than ephemeral keys, an adversary attempting to spawn multiple malicious nodes must dilute their own capital, rendering Sybil attacks fiscally irrational against a staked ledger.
